description: Paginated, sortable list of APIs across providers — filter by tag, provider, artifact type, industry, region, or rating band. `q` is lexical over the API's own name and description; include=["via_provider"] adds APIs of providers whose name matched (the union apis_io_search counts). Use apis_io_search first for a cross-type overview. Parameter reference: apis://docs/tools/find_apis.

context.description: Optional: one sentence on why you are asking. Never used to rank; read only if a result is wrong.

include.description: via_provider: also return APIs of providers whose name matched `q`. Needs `q`.

pricing.description: free | freemium | free-trial | paid | enterprise, e.g. ["free"].

provenance.description: modeled | unpublished | published | documented, e.g. "documented". Omit for all. Meanings: apis://docs/tools/find_apis.

q.description: Free text over name + description, e.g. "sms".

resolve.description: on (default) uses a tag `q` names; off = text only.

tags.description: Tag slugs, e.g. ["payments"]. On providers: what the company does (see api_tags).

try_now.description: Usable at no cost right now (free/trial + self-serve/open).

name: find_apis
